name: Khaasan
backstory: Teletraveller. Always travels by griffon — never on foot or by any other means. Has an uncle in Khan Ice who has never left the place and who expects him without fail; Khaasan has never missed the visit.

experience: Met Aureobalo at a bar in Salthos Cruzados, the evening of the Feria del Milenio's opening — mentioned coming from Khan Ice, just passing through, not there for the fair itself.

Reached Khaoe at the same bar later that evening, griffon in tow as always, and left it outside eating something it shouldn't have; she teased him for cutting it close, and he called her out on pretending she wasn't worried.
Stayed on at the bar after Aureobalo and Khaoe left, talking one-on-one with Bardaglis - teased him about not owning a griffon; Bardaglis said he'd rather keep his earnings than feed one.
Met Nuvilo that same night, when he wandered in hungry after a night of pavilion-hopping - joked that a writer and a bard do the same job, just one sings his.
Left the bar last among the original group, undecided yet on where he needs to be early the next morning.
Left the Feria del Milenio early on its second morning for Khan Ice, to see the uncle who expects him - crossing Khaoe at the entrance on her way in.
Refuses the rail even where it runs (Gorff-Khan Ice, Khan Ice-Balham): 'el tren te deja donde el tren quiere.'
Dismisses Doran's claim that Khan Ice was a wartime capital, on the ground that Doran deduced it from walls without ever having gone.
Agreed to look, with his own eyes, for a house near the water in Khan Ice that Khaoe's grandmother spoke of - and to report only whether it is still standing.
Picked up from Khaoe: her family came from Khan Ice before Khol Moshin, and she has never been.

criterion.standard: counts on being the one who turns up, however far out and however late
criterion.wasted_life: one where someone stopped expecting him
criterion.trusts: being there - his own eyes, his own bird, his own arrival
criterion.distrusts: anyone reporting on a place they only ever heard about
cost_ledger: Keeps and feeds a griffon rather than travel any other way, and gets teased for the expense - Bardaglis would rather keep the earnings (aureobalo_khaasan_bar_salthos_cruzados).
Cut it close reaching Khaoe at the bar and left the griffon outside eating something it shouldn't (khaoe_khaasan_bar_salthos_cruzados).
Left the Feria del Milenio - which happens once in a lifetime - on its second morning, because his uncle was expecting him (khaoe_khaasan_partida_a_khan_ice).

history.cause: khaoe_khaasan_partida_a_khan_ice: Khaoe's tease that he arrived last time with his tongue out and the bird eating something it shouldn't - a direct reference to his anchor scene
history.note: Gate matched: the tease references khaoe_khaasan_bar_salthos_cruzados, his anchor, and challenges the manner of his arrival. He accepted it and reread the case rather than abandoning it - 'Llegue. Es lo unico que se me pide.' Standard unchanged, tempered 0 -> 1. trusts/distrusts deliberately untouched: the challenge came from firsthand testimony by someone who was there, which is exactly the kind of knowing he already trusts, so there is nothing to harden against.
